mentions.name: Hexborne
mentions.description: A hex-based skirmish roguelite deckbuilder where players place units and structures on a hex scenario map to build a base and eliminate their opponent, blending tactical X-Com 2- and Starcraft-style gameplay with card mechanics. Set in a hexpunk world 10,000 years in the future where humans have ascended to godhood and colonized the multiverse, it is being built in Godot with AI agent assistance, with polish work on UI, card templating, art, and tooltips ahead of external playtesting.
